language.title: Khetha ulwimi lwakho
language.subtitle: Ungalutshintsha kamva kwimenyu.
home.subtitle: Khetha ividiyo okanye umfanekiso, yongeza ingoma namagama, uze ukhuphele ividiyo egqityiweyo.
image.lengthBody: Khetha ixesha lo mfanekiso oza kudlala ngalo.
image.audioRequired: Yongeza ingoma. Lo mfanekiso awunayo isandi sayo.
about.title: Malunga
about.copy1: I-AI LyricVid ibeka amagama ahambelana nexesha phezu kwevidiyo. Khetha ikliphu, khangela ingoma, qabula amagama, uze ukhuphele i-MP4 kwigalari yakho.
about.copy2: Ukuhlela nokukhuphela kuhlala kwesi sixhobo. Ukufumanisa ingoma kuthumela ikliphu yesandi emfutshane ku-AudD ukuze kuchongwe ingoma. Akukho akhawunti ifunekayo.
editor.title: Umhleli wamagama
detect.title: Kufunyaniswe ingoma?
detect.body: Kuchongwe isandi sale vidiyo kuze kulayishwe amagama ngokuzenzekelayo?
detect.noLyricsBody: U-{{artist}} — {{title}} uchongiwe, kodwa i-LRCLIB ayinawo amagama. Sebenzisa Khangela amagama ukuze uzame esinye isiphumo.
detect.needsBuild: Ukufumanisa kufuna i-app ye-AI LyricVid ukuze isike ikliphu yesandi emfutshane. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukwenza oku.
detect.unrecognized: I-AudD ayizange iyichonge le kliphu. Zama enye indawo kwividiyo, okanye ukhangele ngegama.
detect.noToken: Seta i-EXPO_PUBLIC_AUDD_API_TOKEN kwi-.env ukuze uvule ukufumanisa ingoma.
media.photoPermission: Imvume yelayibrari yeefoto iyafuneka ukuze ukhethe ividiyo.
search.rateLimit: Umda we-LRCLIB ufikelelwe. Zama kwakhona emva kwemizuzwana engama-{{seconds}}.
lyrics.synced: Amagama alungelelanisiweyo alayishiwe. Cofa umgca ukuze uye apho.
lyrics.beyondVideo: Kuboniswa yonke ingoma. Ukujonga kwangaphambili nokukhuphela kuyema ekupheleni kwevidiyo; imigca elandelayo ihlala kuluhlu.
lyrics.cannotSplitBody: Lo mga ufuna ubuncinane amagama amabini.
lyrics.startFromBody: Cima yonke imigca ngasentla uze uhambise amaxesha ukuze lo uqale ngo-00:00.00.
lyrics.pastePlaceholder: Ncamathelisa i-LRC okanye amagama aqhelekileyo ngalo naluphi na ulwimi
lyrics.warningPaste: Ancamatheliswe njengamagama angalungelelaniswanga. Amaxesha alandela ingoma, hayi ubude bevidiyo.
lyrics.warningUnsynced: Kufunyenwe amagama angalungelelaniswanga kuphela. Amaxesha abelwe ngokulinganayo — walungelelanise kuluhlu.
lyrics.warningNone: Akukho magama abe ncamatheliswe kwesi siphumo.
search.title: Fumana amagama
search.needVideo: Khetha ividiyo kuqala ukuze ufumane ingoma kwisandi sayo.
search.noMatches: Akukho ziphumo kwi-LRCLIB. Zama esinye isihloko okanye wongeze umculi.
search.pickSong: Khetha ingoma. Umhleli uza kubonisa onke amagama, nokuba ividiyo imfutshane.
search.detectNeedVideo: Khetha ividiyo kuqala, uze ufumane ingoma kwisandi sayo.
search.detectNoLyrics: I-AudD ifumene u-{{artist}} — {{title}}, kodwa i-LRCLIB ayinawo amagama. Khangela ngolunye upelo, okanye uncamathelise amagama.
search.footerDetect: Ukufumanisa kuthumela ikliphu yesandi emfutshane ku-AudD, kuze kulayishwe amagama avela kwi-LRCLIB.
search.footerLrc: Amagama nge-LRCLIB · naluphi na ulwimi, njengoko apapashiweyo
split.title: Yahlula umgca
split.help: Cofa igama lokugqibela elimele lihlale kulo mga. Okushiyekileyo kuba ngumgca omtsha ngezantsi.
split.needWords: Lo mga ufuna ubuncinane amagama amabini ukuze wahlulwe.
sync.title: Ukuhambisa ixesha
sync.help: Hambisa yonke imigca kunye ukuba amagama aqala kancinane ngaphambi okanye emva kwevidiyo.
sync.unsynced: La magama awa lungelelaniswanga ngomgca. Sebenzisa ukuhambisa namaxesha ku-Amagama.
audio.keepHelp: Ukujonga kwangaphambili kusebenzisa isandi esele sikhona kwividiyo ({{duration}}).
audio.replaceHelp: Khetha i-mp3 okanye i-wav. Ukujonga kwangaphambili nokukhuphela kuyema kubude bevidiyo ({{duration}}).
audio.imageHelp: Ividiyo iya kuba ngu-{{duration}}. Amagama nokukhuphela kusebenzisa obo bude.
style.hint: Rhuqa ibhokisi yamagama kwividiyo ukuze uyibeke kwakhona.
stickers.help: Cofa isitika ukuze uyongeze, uze uyirhuqe naphi na kwividiyo okanye emfanekisweni. Isihloko sengoma sivela kwisitika.
export.readyShare: {{filename}} ilungile. Sebenzisa iphepha lesistim ukuze uyigcine okanye uyabelane.
export.hiresBody: Esi sandi yi-Hi-Res. Khetha ifayile ye-44.1 okanye 48 kHz, uze ukhuphele kwakhona.
export.expoGo: Vula i-app ye-AI LyricVid kwisakhiwo se-Android/iOS ukuze ukhuphele. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukwenza i-MP4 egqityiweyo.
export.needAudio: Yongeza ifayile yesandi phambi kokukhuphela lo mfanekiso.
export.copyFailed: Ayikwazanga ukukopa ividiyo kugcino lwe-app ukuze ikhutshelwe.
export.alreadyOnDevice: Le vidiyo sele ikwisiqhobo sakho. Gcina iifayile zemibhalo uziqambe ngokufana nevidiyo.
export.needsBuild: Ukukhuphela ividiyo egqityiweyo kufuna i-app ye-AI LyricVid. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukutshisa amagama kwi-MP4. Vula i-app efakelwe kwisakhiwo se-Android/iOS, uze ukhuphele kwakhona.
